basics.name: Zijun Long
basics.label: Assistant Professor, Hunan University
basics.summary: I develop efficient and reliable multimodal learning for information retrieval, robotic perception and industrial visual analysis. My record includes 16 peer-reviewed papers as first, co-first or corresponding author, including ICML, ECCV, SIGIR and ICRA. I am lead supervisor and corresponding author of four student-led papers published in 2026.

work.name: Hunan University, College of Electrical and Information Engineering
highlights: Research on multimodal and interactive retrieval, reliable vision-language models, training-free adaptation, robotic perception and industrial visual learning.
Formal supervision: one PhD student, one master's student and two undergraduates. Broader research mentoring: five graduate and eight undergraduate students.

Teach three courses to 200+ students annually, with 32 contact hours per course: Intelligent Information Processing (graduate, March-June 2026); Professional Writing and Scientific Communication (undergraduate, since September 2026); Satellite Internet Applications for New-Type Power Systems (undergraduate, since September 2026).

work.name: University of Glasgow
highlights: Independently supervised 20 AI-focused MSc dissertations, each accounting for one-third of the degree credits. Six received A grades and ranked within the top 20% of the overall assessed cohort.

work.name: University of Glasgow
highlights: Tutored and assessed Recommender Systems, Text as Data, Introduction to Data Science, Programming, and Machine Learning.

courses: Full PhD scholarship. Thesis: Researching an Enhanced Multimodal Learning Framework for Improved Inter-Modal and Intra-Modal Alignment.
Supervisors: Richard McCreadie and Gerardo Aragon Camarasa.
Distinction; average grade A3; top 5% of the cohort.
